links.outcome: Readability of LLM-generated SCLC patient education responses across seven readability indices
links.effect: All seven readability indices differed across models (all p ≤ 0.006); Wenxin Yiyan had highest median FRES 25.50 (20.50, 34.50); DeepSeek and Doubao generally produced more linguistically complex text.
links.quote: Wenxin Yiyan had the highest median FRES [25.50 (20.50, 34.50)] and relatively low GFOG, FKGL, CL, and SMOG values; DeepSeek and Doubao generally produced more linguistically complex text.

screen.reason: The study is a benchmarking evaluation comparing five LLMs on answering small cell lung cancer questions for patient education suitability, quality, and readability, without testing a specific organizational deployment safeguard or practice.
